title: Evidence export manifest, version 1
description: manifest.json of an evidence export. The export is a ZIP file. The manifest lists every other file of the export with its size and SHA-256. The same request on the same stored records gives the same bytes: the manifest holds no request time. A display calculation in an export carries its rule. The manifest does not list itself.

subject.description: The record that the export starts from.

exported_by.description: The client whose view the export holds. Blinding and the cohort guard apply to an agent's export.

contracts_source.description: The database repository commit of the API's contract copy.

artifacts.description: none: the export lists artifacts with their SHA-256 but holds no artifact file. all: the export holds each listed artifact file.

withheld.description: Value groups that blinding withheld from the exporting client.

protected_excluded.description: Observations that the cohort guard left out of the export.

limitations.description: Scientific and technical limits of the exported content, for example the status of the method.

content.description: readme: the description of the export. run, observations, measurements, records, methods: API views as JSON or CSV. artifact: a stored artifact file.

stored_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the stored artifact. It equals sha256 unless blinding redacted the file.

redacted.description: True when blinding removed values from this file.
